summary: Enhance your understanding of monetary policy with our advanced economic modeling training. Equip yourself with essential skills for effective decision-making.
lede: Economic modeling for monetary policy helps policy teams assess forecasts and decisions under uncertainty. For central bank economists, forecasting teams, and policy analysts, the course covers preparing macroeconomic data, comparing forecasting approaches, evaluating model fit and stability, and testing scenarios and policy trade-offs. Participants also interpret shocks and transmission channels and communicate assumptions, uncertainty, and results in decision-ready briefings.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals engaged in the intricate world of monetary policy and macroeconomic analysis.
audience: Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) secretariat and technical
Analysts in financial regulators and supervisory authorities
Policy analysts in think tanks and research
modules: Monetary Policy Questions That Models Must Answer
Forecasting for Policy: Time-Series Models That Work
Semi-Structural Policy Models for Central Banking
DSGE Modeling for Monetary Policy Analysis
Scenario Analysis, Stress Testing, and Policy Trade-offs
prerequisites: Participants should have a solid understanding of macroeconomic principles and basic econometrics. Experience with economic modeling or policy analysis is recommended.
